title: El Salvador: Romero and the civil war
goal: I can tell how Archbishop Romero died and how the civil war went, using cuando and mientras.

items: I can say when and how Archbishop Romero was killed, using cuando and mientras.
I can say when the civil war lasted and about how many people died.
I can say what happened at El Mozote and who gives the figure.
I can use cuando and mientras to link events in the past.
I can use the new words for the archbishop, the massacre and inequality.
